subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
7.  
If the weighting of equity in total capital is 1/3, that of debt is 2/3, the return on equity is 
15% that of debt is 10% and the corporate tax rate is 32%, what is the Weighted Average 
Cost of Capital (WACC)?  
(A)  
10.533%  
(B)  
7.533%  
(C)  
9.533%  
(D)  
11.350%     
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (C) 9.533% Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) After-tax Cost of Debt: 10% × (1 - 0.32) = 6.8% WACC = 1 3 (15%) + 2 3 (6.8%) = 5% + 4.533% = 9.533%
